headline: Quiet Saturday; Grok abuse-image lawsuit adds a sliver of backlash
body: A quiet day. The only scored story: a Wyoming woman joined a federal lawsuit alleging xAI's Grok was used to create about 7,000 sexualised images from a childhood photo. Cases like this feed Tech Backlash, which gave Reversion a tiny lift. Everything else simply drifted by a few hundredths as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance stands at -1.54.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Reversion +0.07, from the Grok lawsuit (+0.04) and fading earlier news (+0.02); Descendants -0.06, from fading earlier news (-0.06).
